notes:
- All ports names the project a dev server runs in, the app beside each process, and how each port got started: Terminal, zsh, claude, node.
- Open any process for when it started, what it costs, its ports and what it is connected to, with Copy as text and Quit for your own.
- New marks what started in the last ten minutes; what quit stays dimmed for ten minutes, so a dev server that died is noticed.
- The battery menu bar item can show the battery with its percentage inside.
- Choose how many apps the glance lists, 3 to 20.
- Memory shows pressure and swap over time.
- The GPU tab opens each app to its processes' GPU share.
- Apps exports its list: copy for a spreadsheet, or save as CSV.
- Apps shows idle wake ups per app, and Settings has a search field.
- Bluetooth keeps a connected device that reports no battery, and says so.
